name: SheepFarm register/addGems input validation
summary: SheepFarm's register()/addGems() credit gems without validating the caller's actual BNB deposit, so the attacker minted gems for free and repeatedly withdrew the farm's BNB.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/sheepfarm.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: SheepFarm 0x4726010da871f4b57b5031E3EA48Bde961F122aA created 2022-11-09T10:38:06Z by 0x3f99830a7f0b919a4ef1d462055255faa0bb1c72, unrelated to attack sender 0x2131c67ed7b6aa01b7aa308c71991ef5baedd049; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs carries two PoCs (SheepFarm_exp and SheepFarm2_exp) for the same incident; one row is recorded. Loss verified onchain: the farm's BNB balance fell from 935.46 BNB at block 23088155 to zero by block 23095000 and the attacker EOA went from 0.0896 BNB to 261.948 BNB, a net 261.8586 BNB; 261.8586 BNB x $275.10 at incidentTimestamp 1668550412 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $72,038.

limitations: Classification and loss came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/sheepfarm.json; legacy measurement.status=OK is provenance only.
